erasure.title: Erasure requests
erasure.subtitle: Open GDPR erasure requests by deadline (one month, Art. 12(3)).

actions.retryDone: Erasure completed — the subject was notified.
actions.retryPartial: Erasure ran, but some stores still failed.
actions.emailRequired: Enter the subject's email to retry — it is checked against the request and never stored.
actions.closeDescription: Use this when the request was handled outside the system (for example erased by hand, or a duplicate). The note is kept as the record.
actions.notePlaceholder: e.g. Erased by hand in Sanity on 30 Sept

errors.email_mismatch: That email does not match this request.
errors.not_retryable: Only a confirmed (stuck) request can be retried.
errors.clerk_failed: Clerk still refuses the account deletion — try again later.
errors.clerk_email_changed: The subject's Clerk account now uses another email, so a retry would miss it. Delete the account in Clerk, then close this request manually.
errors.clerk_unavailable: Clerk did not answer — try again later.
errors.unavailable: The API is missing its erasure configuration (Clerk or Sanity secrets) — ask a developer.
errors.changed: The request changed while the retry ran (another retry or a manual close) — reload the page.
errors.note_required: Write a note of 5 to 500 characters.
